sentences.en: I do my work every day.
He does the work at home.
I get a letter from her.
She gives a present to him.
I take a cup of tea.
You take the book from the table.
We put the box on the shelf.
sentences.zh: 我们把盒子放在架子上。

sentences.en: They put the chairs in the room.
sentences.zh: 他们把椅子放在房间里。
